issue_context.title: Parser support for _ujis, _CP932 literal
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
see the following testcase. While ujis is not supported as a character set, it is useful to add the parser syntax and a more useful error message to explain this.
```sql
Select CAST((LAG(_UJIS '8CA} ',144) OVER()) AS TIME);
Select LAST_DAY(LEAD( _CP932 '',241)OVER(RANGE UNBOUNDED PRECEDING));
```
### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```sql
mysql> Select CAST((LAG(_UJIS '8CA} ',144) OVER()) AS TIME);
+-----------------------------------------------+
| CAST((LAG(_UJIS '8CA} ',144) OVER()) AS TIME) |
+-----------------------------------------------+
| NULL                                          |
+-----------------------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> Select LAST_DAY(LEAD( _CP932 '',241)OVER(RANGE UNBOUNDED PRECEDING));
+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| LAST_DAY(LEAD( _CP932 '',241)OVER(RANGE UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)) |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| NULL                                                          |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```sql
mysql> Select CAST((LAG(_UJIS '8CA} ',144) OVER()) AS TIME);
ERROR 1064 (42000): You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your TiDB version for the right syntax to use line 1 column 30 near "'8CA} ',144) OVER()) AS TIME)" 
mysql> Select LAST_DAY(LEAD( _CP932 '',241)OVER(RANGE UNBOUNDED PRECEDING));
ERROR 1064 (42000): You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your TiDB version for the right syntax to use line 1 column 31 near "'',241)OVER(RANGE UNBOUNDED PRECEDING))" 
```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
```sql
| Release Version: v5.5.0-alpha-60-g8c70432b0-dirty
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 8c70432b000d648e9ea26cc57a7fe79d2e67d341
Git Branch: master
UTC Build Time: 2022-01-07 17:47:06
GoVersion: go1.16.9
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306
Check Table Before Drop: false |
```
comments: Those charsets are not supported by TiDB, and they're not in the roadmap for now.
Please check whether the issue should be labeled with 'affects-x.y' or 'fixes-x.y.z', and then remove 'needs-more-info' label.

This was a feature request / bug report to return a clearer error message, since in other instances we tend to do this correctly. It is not specifically a request to implement the ujis character set.

This might help some users who are migrating that are less familiar with parser error messages, so I think we can leave this open but with lower priority.

review_comments: Can you explain the rename? It's not a huge deal, but there are some users using this as a library. Renaming `CharsetBinary` to `CharsetBin` might cause them some issues. But if `Bin` is more correct, I have no problem with it.
We had `CharsetBin` and `CharsetBinary` in parser before. I found we use `CharsetBin` more often, so I decided delete `CharsetBinary`.
The second argument here is still an error. If you don't check for it, our linter will complain.
The linter can be passed, the previous failed was caused by ci.
